headline: Pipeline Operator NTS to Sue Over Brazilian Regulator ANP Asset Decision
summary: Brazilian pipeline operator NTS announced plans to take legal action to suspend a decision by the National Petroleum and Gas Agency regarding the company's asset base in the southeast network.
why: Regulatory decisions regarding pipeline asset bases directly impact the allowable tariffs and long-term cash flows of regulated infrastructure utilities.

impacts.name: NTS
impacts.why: NTS is pursuing legal action against a regulatory decision by the ANP.
